description: This file contains service functions for managing exercise logs and body metrics in a gym management system, including creation and listing with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: create_exercise_log
methods.description: Creates a new exercise log entry for a user.

methods.name: list_exercise_logs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of exercise logs for a user with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: create_body_metrics
methods.description: Creates a new body metrics snapshot for a user.

methods.name: list_body_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of body metrics snapshots for a user with optional filters and pagination.
